h1: SP Resort and Garden Phichit — Quiet Countryside Houses with In-Room Kitchens, Under ฿500
intro: If you want a private, house-style stay in Phichit where you can cook for yourself, surrounded by a quiet green garden away from town bustle — SP Resort and Garden is a small roadside resort on Route 115 in the Wachirabarami district. Rooms are detached and semi-detached houses with their own little kitchens, sofas, flat-screen TVs and fridges, with parking right outside your door. It starts at around ฿437/night, with daily and monthly stays available.

body.html: What sets SP Resort and Garden apart from the usual in-town Phichit hotels is that the rooms are houses, not rooms in a block. You can pick detached or semi-detached units, each with a small in-room kitchen, a fridge, a sofa, a flat-screen TV and air-conditioning. It suits travellers who want to cook for themselves or stay several days rather than just overnight, which is why the resort rents by the day, the week and the month — handy for people working or handling longer business in Phichit.

The setting is right on Route 115 in the Wachirabarami district, out beyond Phichit town in a quiet stretch of rice-field countryside, with green garden grounds around the property. The upside is genuine quiet and easy access — you park right outside your room. The honest catch is that this location is well away from restaurants and the town centre; without your own car it would be awkward. Some guests bluntly describe it as being "out in the fields," but with a car it's an easy drive to town or a roadside convenience store.

What real reviews praise most is how clean the rooms are and how friendly the owner and staff are. Several guests were surprised that a room in the ฿300–400 range came in cleaner and better equipped than expected. The garden atmosphere makes it feel more like staying at a country home than a hotel. Staff speak both Thai and English, look after guests well, and the front desk is open 24 hours.

"The rooms are separate little houses with their own kitchens — cleaner than the price suggests, the owner is lovely, and it's wonderfully quiet. Great if you have a car and want a relaxed, fuss-free stay."

What you need to accept is that this is a small garden-house resort, not a full-service hotel. There's no swimming pool, no breakfast included, and no on-site restaurant — if you're hungry you either drive out or cook in your kitchen. The styling is plain country-house, not luxurious or sharply modern, so if you're expecting a polished, heavily styled hotel, this isn't that kind of place.

One more thing to know before you book: online reviews here are still thin. On platforms like TripAdvisor and Agoda the review count is low, so the average score can swing on just a handful of guests. The voices that are there lean positive on cleanliness and quiet, but it's worth keeping expectations open and contacting the property directly to confirm the room condition and current rates for your dates.

Overall, SP Resort and Garden suits self-drivers who want a private house with a kitchen, real quiet, and a budget price — or anyone needing a longer stay in Phichit on a monthly rate. Rates start around ฿437 a night and drop further for longer stays. It isn't the place if you want to walk to restaurants or sightsee in the town centre, but for private, country-garden quiet at an easy price, it's a worthwhile option in Phichit.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — SP Resort and Garden Phichit

faq.q: Where is SP Resort and Garden located in Phichit?
faq.a: It's at 27 Moo 11, Route 115, Wachirabarami District, Phichit — a roadside garden resort on Route 115 in the rice-field countryside outside Phichit town. It's about a 25-minute drive from the town centre and Bueng Si Fai, best suited to self-drivers.

faq.q: How much does SP Resort and Garden cost, and can I rent monthly?
faq.a: Rates start from approximately ฿437/night for a house-style room. The resort rents daily, weekly and monthly — for longer stays, ask the property about monthly rates for a better deal. Prices vary by season, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at SP Resort and Garden — do they have kitchens?
faq.a: Rooms are detached and semi-detached houses with a small in-room kitchen, plus a fridge, sofa, flat-screen TV and air-conditioning — ideal if you want to cook for yourself or stay longer. They're plain country-house style and, per real reviews, clean.

faq.q: Does SP Resort and Garden have breakfast or a swimming pool?
faq.a: No breakfast is included and there's no swimming pool. There's no on-site restaurant either, but each room has a kitchen so you can cook your own meals — otherwise you'll need to drive out for food. For a hotel with a pool and breakfast, consider a suburban resort in Phichit instead.

faq.q: Does SP Resort and Garden have parking and allow pets?
faq.a: Yes — free parking right outside your room and a 24-hour front desk. It is pet-friendly (please confirm with the property to be sure). The quiet rice-field location suits self-drivers who want a private, relaxed stay.

faq.q: Who is SP Resort and Garden best for?
faq.a: It's best for self-drivers who want a private house with a kitchen, real quiet, and a budget price, or anyone needing a longer monthly stay in Phichit. It isn't about luxury or a central location, but it's great value if you like private, country-garden quiet.
